turns.user: How much do you pay for a GP visit?
turns.reply: We pay up to €60 per GP visit, for a maximum of 8 visits per policy year.

tool_calls.result:
[02_cover_and_limits#3]
Cover and annual limits. At the limit. A claim for exactly the limit, for example 60 for a GP visit, is within the limit.

[02_cover_and_limits#4]
Cover and annual limits. Reaching your annual limit. Once you have used all the visits or items for a treatment type in a policy year, further claims of that type in the same policy year are not paid. For example, after 8 paid GP visits, a ninth GP visit in the same policy year is not covered.

[02_cover_and_limits#2]
